name: Sixth Night
source:
This is a story in a collapsed city.
After the economic collapse, unemployment soared and people lost hope.
At this time, a special software appeared on the smart phone.
Through this software, you can enter the magical space and be served by a lovely girl.
Hikaru, the man who just lost his job, used this software before he kill himself.
But in the magical space, he met the girl Miyuki.
Six nights later, his life began to change.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/944050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个发生在一座倒塌城市里的故事。
经济崩溃后，失业率飙升，人们失去了希望。
这时，智能手机上出现了一款特殊的软件。
通过这款软件，你可以进入神奇的空间，并有可爱的女孩为你服务。
刚刚失业的男子光在自杀前使用了这个软件。
但在魔法空间里，他遇见了女孩美雪。
六个晚上后，他的生活开始发生变化。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/944050/]Steam[/url]]
